## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `aa492785be7fa26ee93c3d07dfc97025d087e08a`
Local-runs: none

Face: governed rule text (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`; Tier S, `.claude/**`), reviewed in-seat by the dispatching seat at the constant's tier. Inputs: #21048 (body and every comment: the triage grade 5924816890, the seat's claim 5942779919, the dev report 5943127817), PR #21269's body, its file list (2 files, +2 / −2) and patch against `main` at `ee42f00e`, and the check-runs on this head as read at this record.

### ① Derived judgments

1. Scope: two lines rewritten in place, one per file, both inside the claim's surface; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (frozen, ruling 208 R6) and the 〈升级与决策〉 frame block are untouched (`check:skill-frame-sync` is `success` on this head). RIGHT.
2. The premise narrowing holds on `main`: `ceilingTierSpellings()` lists `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER_NAME` first (dispatch-gates.mjs about `:12892`; the constant about `:12445`; landed in `47849e720`, 2026-09-27), and `readContainerModelLine` reads a ceiling spelled by the NAME when the same line carries `MANDATORY` or `reason:`; the self-test battery about `:26008`–`:26020` pins exactly the triage's two pins. The template half is therefore the whole remaining defect, and this diff is that half. RIGHT.
3. SKILL.md 〈模板与表〉: the `model:` placeholder now reads — the tier word quoting this run's `--tier` output; the ceiling spelled `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, citing on the same line the MANDATORY path line or a `reason:`; never copy the model id. That is what the recogniser accepts and what the comment rule in both repos' `AGENTS.md` permits; the seat's own claims this round (5942779919, 5942801994) are written in this shape and passed the claim reader before posting — a live measurement of the template. The line is fenced, so the 120-byte cap does not apply (`check:pm-skill-ratchet` success). RIGHT.
4. `execution-duties.md` 〈认领〉: 「档位引 `dispatch-gates --tier --repo 仓`⛔ 不凭记忆;天花板拼常量名并同行引据,⛔ 不抄模型 id」 keeps the old sentence's rule (cite this run's `--tier`, never memory) and adds the ceiling spelling rule, in 119 bytes; the hard-coded `--repo objectstack-ai/objectstack PATHS` becomes the sister-repo form, which is the case the card is about and the file's own idiom for `--commands`. 「当次」 survives in the SKILL.md template and in 「不凭记忆」. RIGHT; no rule lost.
5. One spelling for every repo: both `AGENTS.md` files carry the identical comment rule, so a model-id spelling is legal in no repo's claim; the triage left this to the claim and the PR body states the reason. RIGHT.
6. No accept-set or public-surface change; `.claude/**` publishes nothing. The boundary the dev names (default and floor tiers stay ladder words; no model-free equivalent; `dispatch-gates.mjs` frozen, no new vocabulary) is correctly left outside this PR and recorded in its Acceptance notes. RIGHT.
7. Line ratchet: SKILL.md 319 → 319 (ceiling 319), execution-duties.md 183 → 183 (ceiling 183); `check:pm-skill-id-lint` 34 files clean, so no issue number entered the protocol text. RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` only: nothing published moves; `skip-changeset` applied and right. `Clause-②: no` is right: nothing is accepted or rejected differently. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation: the suggested wording was shortened to the 120-byte bullet cap, with the literal tokens kept on the fenced SKILL.md line. Accepted: the bullet states the rule, the template carries the tokens.
- Dev deviation: `check:doc-formula-expressions` answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and exit 0 after `formula` and `lint` were built under the verify lock. Accepted; a prerequisite, not a red.
- `open_questions`: none. Two 「noted, not filed」 items (the default/floor-tier boundary; no third protocol site teaches quoting `--tier` into the slot) stay noted.
- Check-runs on `aa492785` at this record: 17 `success` (TypeScript Type Check, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, the claim and single-writer checks among them), 12 skipped by the paths filter for a `.claude/**`-only diff, 1 `in_progress` (`Lint & Repo Gates`), 0 `failure`. Tier S landing: the seat enqueues once `Lint & Repo Gates` concludes `success`.
